prompt: A three-part demo in the axis vocabulary: a sparse intro, a verse that develops, and a drop that hits harder, in C minor with a TR-909 kit.

requests.ask: give each section a harmonic identity

changes.why: the drop gets its own progression (i VI III VII) so the climax moves harmonically, not just in density
the melody rides a slow saw from dark to bright over the 8 bars so the verse builds toward the drop
the pad arpeggiates upward to add motion under the busier drums
